title: Surreal Porhole Dreamscape
description: A circular porthole-like frame contains a surreal night seascape. Inside the frame are a cracked moon with a cloud, multiple ornate ships floating on dark water, a large green candle with a flame, rows of purple theater seats emerging from the sea, and a Ferris wheel in the distance.
prompt: Surreal circular porthole frame with rivets and keys, looking into a dark sea at dusk. A large cracked moon hangs in an orange sky, several ornate ghost ships float on the water, a giant melting green candle stands tall with a bright flame, rows of purple theater seats rise from the sea leading toward the candle, and a distant Ferris wheel is visible. Feathers, barnacles and keys decorate the frame, moody and dreamlike atmosphere.
